name: PI-Desktop
description: Local-first AI coding agent desktop: Electron + Rust host core + pi Agent Harness + user-installable plugins
one_liner: A desktop app that gives your AI coding assistant its own dedicated workspace — projects, sessions, reviews, and plugins in one window — instead of living inside a terminal.
buyer: An individual developer or small dev team lead who juggles multiple AI coding sessions across projects and wants a single control-room UI instead of many terminal tabs.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer manages several client codebases and AI sessions side by side in one desktop workspace instead of switching terminal windows.
A small dev team standardizes on this as their shared AI coding environment, building internal plugins for their specific stack.
A dev-tools company builds and sells premium plugins (themes, panels, specialized reviewers) for this ecosystem.

money_ideas.idea: Sell premium plugins (specialized code reviewers, deployment panels, team dashboards) in a plugin marketplace.
Offer a hosted team-sync tier so multiple developers can share sessions, permissions, and project state.

steal_this: Build one high-value plugin for this desktop (e.g. a Jira/Linear sync panel) and sell it for $15 as an early ecosystem product this weekend.
